review: Stage7 WGPU second-world cache fixture root correction

failure_evidence.old_expectation: Zero uploads for the two default sheets immediately after loading the complete Demo.

root_cause.result: Obsolete unbounded-retention assumption in this fixture; no production cache defect identified.
root_cause.identity_proof: Both Demo source defaults and the old tiny fixture name core:carpet_beige_01 and core:ceiling_panel_01. They resolve the same unchanged catalog PNG content with Surface / BaseColorDisplay / Repeat / High GPU keys. Source currentness and installed asset identities are unchanged; quality is High for both commits.
root_cause.removal_path: install_prepared clones the current texture cache then calls begin_level at unchanged quality. begin_level trims optional persistent entries to 256 entries / 268435456 resident bytes, largest first with deterministic identity ties. Same-key misses in the observed second upload therefore reflect optional cache eviction, rather than new authored identities or a quality change.

cost_evidence.qualification: Bounded read-only PLMP6 header/run inspection and embedded PNG dimension arithmetic, not a native cache-map or process-RSS measurement. Additional character, dynamic, sky and effect textures are omitted. This component estimate is supporting evidence; the unchanged-key source path and observed misses identify the removal mechanism.

root_cause.contract: Zero uploads when moving from a complete Demo to an arbitrary other world is not guaranteed by bounded retention. Reuse is asserted for a controlled pair that survives retention, followed by an identical repeat.

fixture_and_assertions: Only this test receives explicit outdoor:concrete_pavement_01 floor and outdoor:house_siding_01 ceiling/default wall. Both ordinary catalog sheets are 512x512 and already drawn by the maintained Demo concrete paths and exterior house walls. No asset, PNG, map source or shared _second_level helper changes.
Uses ordinary existing Load actions: ready:places_demo -> second level; first ready:second -> identical second reload. Existing first-occurrence anchors bound the action sequence.

Requires three gpu_ready, scene_presented, world upload and world_committed records. Preserves nonempty replacement geometry and different first/second worlds; requires exact second/repeat geometry and a genuine compiled-cache hit.

Both replacement and repeat require exactly (unique,uploaded,hits,fallbacks,missing,draws) = (2,0,2,0,0,2). Both native full mip chains require exactly 2796200 resident bytes and 512px maximum edge. No arbitrary upload allowance, fallback substitution, cache clearing or raised retention cap.

Retains exact initial Demo dynamic counts (16 objects/26 draws), and requires both subsequent scenes to contain zero dynamic objects/draws/vertices. Checks consistent renderer/game level and quality, unchanged selected quality/lightmaps/reflections/bloom, identical repeated gameplay state, material quality, zero normals and complete material diagnostic equality.
Existing native GPU validation/panic/benchmark checks remain. The former loads[1][3] assertion was a fallback counter; both fallback and actual missing counters are now required to be zero.

validation.python_ast: Passed by read-only ast.parse, without importing or executing the test module.
